customers_say: Customers find this door lock to be a premium smart lock with triple deadlocks for high security and multiple unlocking options. They appreciate its appearance, adding a modern touch to the door, and find the installation process simple. The functionality receives positive feedback, with one customer highlighting the password masking feature. However, the app experience receives negative feedback, with customers describing it as terrible.

reviews.title: Good solid lock
reviews.body: Installation process was smooth and the technician explained all features in detail. The lock seems good, 1 week after installation. The fingerprint sensor is sensitive and works fine. The doorbell feature makes urban lockpro stand out as compared to other locks.
